exposure: All source terminal outcomes and the fixed-model aggregate scores are exposed. One sealed packet forecast was inspected. The recovery rationale follows earlier exposed panels and the paper. New calculations are development diagnostics, not independent confirmation.

paired_estimand.W: Success of the incoming-packet writer read
paired_estimand.S: Success of the rewritten successor under evaluation forcing
paired_estimand.D: Success of the preserved incoming packet under identical evaluation forcing
paired_estimand.comparison: One complete writer renewal versus retaining the protected incoming packet; does not isolate writing from writer-stage damage and is not a long-horizon policy benefit.
paired_estimand.weighting: Uniform frozen founders, packets within each original class and probes. Conditional rates are ratios of pooled counts, equivalent to ratios of founder-average masses with this balanced panel. Report all denominators, founder values and leave-one-founder-out values. Absent strata yield null, never zero.
paired_estimand.noise_comparison: Report both regimes separately. Conditioning on a noisy W outcome changes the mixture; do not interpret their conditional difference as an unconfounded causal noise effect.

transition_model.name: transition64_jeffreys
transition_model.time_zero: First native read at g15, estimated from probes; target g15 is never an input.
assumptions: Time-homogeneous Markov reduction in the binary state
Probe transitions transport to descendant packets
transition_model.empty_rows: Use the declared symmetric prior and flag every prior-only row. Empirical rates remain null for absent conditioning states. No prior tuning or selected subsets.

forecast_comparators: All 27 frozen forecasts are retained; highlight fixed quadratic_successor64, all five fixed direct64 heads, direct8, and boundary/signed-transfer comparators. The raw transition reduction does not use B11; learned comparators do.
scoring: Individual-repeat Brier loss, then equal packet and founder averages; both original classes and balanced totals. Report all 30 models. Keep trajectory agreement and uninterrupted success separate from terminal success.
historical_specificity: Native success requires the original taught rule at all four cue/port entries. Classify the opposite rule separately from neither. This is a narrow task distinction, not arbitrary inherited memory.
uncertainty: Eight founder blocks; report founder-level gains and leave-one-out ranges. No new significance gate, power claim, equivalence claim, winner selection or model fitting.
decision: Descriptive diagnosis only. A new prospective advantage study would need a separate frozen horizon, shift, uncertainty rule and justified practical margin.
